rule_or_requirement: User asks visible farther map and remembered observations to support early steering and acceleration, preserving original stable completion.
observable_information: Current and prior images/HUD and own actions only; connected road components and optical flow.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Four mechanisms: connected path pursuit, dual near/far feedforward, motion-compensated path memory, shared path steering and acceleration.
expected_success_endpoint: 6/6 control finishes preserved with lower finished median; target half time remains distinct.
falsifier: No farther path action activation, incorrect component/flow, lost completion, no time gain or invalid action.
